title: A Roman soldier had seen hundreds of executions.
paragraphs:
A Roman soldier had seen hundreds of executions.
But something about this one was different.

The darkness.
The earthquake.
The way Jesus died.
And in that moment… the man trained to enforce Rome said:
“Surely this was the Son of God.”
Sometimes the people who start farthest away end up seeing the clearest.
Have you ever had a moment that changed what you believed?
Not everyone recognizes truth at the same moment.

Some grow up around it.
Some search for years.

And some…
only realize it when they stand at the cross.
“Sometimes the people who least expect to believe… see the truth most clearly.”
